# Asset provenance

`uccs-cu-lockup-reverse.svg` is an unchanged university asset downloaded on October 31, 2026 from the header artwork used by the official UCCS brand website:

https://brand.uccs.edu/themes/custom/mountainlion/CU_ColoradoSprings_Main_Lockup_Reverse.svg

SHA-256: `b9ad3c84f8bce0f09631be4e27c37016ec87aff30a1b7299b23f3a1c72b1a9c0`

The SVG's paths, colors, wordmark, and viewBox are not edited. CSS scales the complete image proportionally on a black background. The downloaded asset retains its supplied internal clear space. The visible project label continues to identify this site as an independent student prototype rather than an endorsed university service.

Review approved artwork, clear space, sizing, and intended use with the relevant university contact before official deployment. Asset availability does not establish project approval. Do not redraw or distort the mark.

References:

- https://brand.uccs.edu/logos-and-marks
- https://brand.uccs.edu/visual-guidelines/typography

`../favicon.svg` is the existing original prototype favicon; it is retained unchanged in Phase 2. The interface uses the existing locally defined outline icons in `app.js`. No external icon library or font request was added.
